result.note: Minor consular advisory; tested its two concrete elements in one statements question.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, the Ministry of External Affairs issued an advisory warning Indians travelling to Russia against joining the Russian armed forces. Consider the following statements about it:
items: The ministry noted that some Indians had asked to give up their citizenship so they could take a Russian passport and enlist.
The advisory urged Indians to vet any job offer from agents not registered with the ministry.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both points appear in the advisory, which called enlisting a dangerous path that the government strongly discourages. The ministry said many Indians were seeking such offers willingly for the money and expected the government to secure their release later.
questions.source: It urged Indians to vet any job offer from agents not registered with the ministry.
